baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition joins تَمْنُن at word 2 to تَسْتَكْثِرُ at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A benefaction is made socially heavy by reminding, counting, or imposing it, and that weight becomes leverage for acquiring abundance or superiority.

activation_trace.role: The weighty favor or reminder supplies the interpersonal burden that the prohibition blocks.
Rivalry through abundance supplies the sought social advantage for which the favor could be used.

changed_reading.before: Do not give in order to receive more.
changed_reading.after: Do not convert a good deed into a burden on its recipient and then use that burden to outnumber, outrank, or extract more.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cutting branch of تَمْنُن at word 2 is negated while word 3 names pursuit of increase.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pursuit of greater volume can interrupt or diminish an undertaking's extension; the prohibition can therefore regulate continuity as well as exchange.

activation_trace.role: Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the threatened interruption of ongoing work.
Numerical growth supplies the scale objective that can displace continuity.

changed_reading.before: Do not stop while trying to obtain more.
changed_reading.after: Do not cut short or thin out the sustained work because the desire for scale has taken control of it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The measured-weight branch of تَمْنُن at word 2 meets numerical abundance in word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Once service is weighed and counted as one's own large contribution, quantity becomes a basis for self-magnification and further claims.

activation_trace.role: A named measure or weighed amount supplies the ledger-like treatment of the deed.
Abundance and numerical increase supply the inflated total produced by that ledger.

changed_reading.before: Do not regard what you give as much.
changed_reading.after: Do not weigh up your service into a large personal total from which status or entitlement can be claimed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sustaining-strength branch of تَمْنُن at word 2 can be heard against the drive for abundance at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Scale-seeking can consume the inner strength by which the work stands, so increase becomes self-defeating when it exhausts capacity.

activation_trace.role: Sustaining strength or its loss supplies the finite capacity endangered by overreach.
Increase in amount supplies the expansion pressure that can spend that capacity.

changed_reading.after: Do not pursue scale in a way that drains the very strength needed to carry the charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening commission assigns rising action, sovereignty and magnitude to the Lord, and restrained persistence to the addressee. Inside that frame, 74:6 prevents service from becoming a mechanism for enlarging the servant.

activation_trace.role: The burdensome favor supplies the self-serving leverage excluded from the commission.
Rivalrous abundance supplies the forbidden enlargement of the agent through service.
Resolute rising to an affair supplies the outward task within which motive is disciplined.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty assign ultimate ownership of the undertaking away from the servant.
Magnifying something in the breast directs magnitude toward the Lord rather than the agent's yield.
Holding the self against agitation supplies the persistent, non-acquisitive posture after the prohibition.

structural_cues: 74:6 is embedded in the imperative chain of 74:2-7 rather than standing as an isolated maxim about exchange.
The sequence moves from rising and warning to magnifying the Lord, disciplining the agent, and persisting for the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commissioned task, the Lord as sovereign and object of magnification, and self-restraint; I infer that 74:6 governs the worker's motive inside that task. A narrower rule limited to material gifts remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Do not use a favor to obtain more.
changed_reading.after: While carrying the commission, do not turn service into a contest that enlarges the servant; act and persist while magnitude and ownership remain with the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command first separates the addressee from disturbance, then negates the cutting sense latent in تَمْنُن, then commands self-restraint. The resulting mechanism distinguishes a necessary break from contamination from a scale-driven break in the work.

activation_trace.role: Cutting or diminishing extension supplies the prohibited interruption at the center of the sequence.
Numerical increase supplies the motive that wrongly interrupts continuity.
Disturbance and repeated agitation supply the contaminating movement from which separation is commanded.
Separation and severance supply the legitimate target and direction of cutting.
Holding the self supplies continuity after the prohibition and blocks restless scale-seeking.

structural_cues: 74:6 stands between commanded severance in 74:5 and commanded restraint in 74:7.
The three adjacent imperatives distinguish what must be left from what must be sustained.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disturbance, commanded separation, the focus root's cutting image, and subsequent restraint; I infer a contrast between cutting off impurity and cutting off the mission for scale. The focus verb can still carry the more direct favor-reminding sense instead.

changed_reading.before: Do not interrupt an undertaking merely to increase its quantity.
changed_reading.after: Sever the contaminant, not the work: do not let appetite for scale break the continuity that patience must preserve.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later figure receives wealth, continued extension, and thorough preparation, yet turns this history of favor into an appetite for further increase. This supplies the recipient-side mirror of the focus verse's donor-side leverage: both appropriate grace into a claim.

activation_trace.role: A favor made weighty supplies the claim-producing treatment of what was given.
Abundance and increase supply the desired return around which entitlement forms.
The acquisition and abundance of wealth supply a concrete history of received provision.
Connected increase that supplies further support makes the provision extended rather than momentary.
A prior hand of beneficence supplies the remembered favor that can be misread as entitlement.
The heart's covetous hope supplies the conversion of received good into expectation.
Seeking and bidding for an increment supplies the explicit demand for still more.

structural_cues: 74:11-15 narrates solitary creation, layered provision, and then the temporal turn ثُمَّ into craving for addition.
The wording of 74:15 closely restages the focus verse's increase mechanism from the recipient's side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulated gifts followed by craving for addition; I infer that this condemned figure is a mirror warning against appropriating favor into entitlement. The imperative in 74:6 may still address only the giver's motive, so the recipient-side extension is contextual rather than syntactic.

changed_reading.before: A giver must not burden another with a favor to get more back.
changed_reading.after: Neither giving nor receiving may be converted into entitlement: do not burden another with grace, and do not recast grace already received as a claim to further increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later makes a number itself a test while naming increase in faith as a positive effect. Quantity and increase are therefore not rejected absolutely; the focus verse rejects counting service toward self-return and redirects growth toward trust.

activation_trace.role: A weighed measure supplies the focus verse's potentially self-serving ledger.
Numerical abundance supplies the morally ambiguous category that context revalues.
Growth and increase supply a positively directed increase whose object is faith rather than self-return.
Enumerating what is counted supplies the number that becomes an occasion of testing.
Testing metal or a person supplies the diagnostic function assigned to the count.
Heart-settling assent supplies the non-rivalrous quality into which increase may properly flow.

structural_cues: 74:31 places explicit counting, testing, and increase in faith in one causal sentence.
The same surah thus contains both censured increase-seeking and affirmed increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies count-as-test and faith-as-increasing; I infer that the object and ownership of growth, not quantity by itself, determine the contrast with 74:6. The later sentence need not be a direct gloss on the earlier syntax.

changed_reading.before: Do not measure your contribution or seek increase.
changed_reading.after: Do not count service into personal surplus; let the test of number increase settled trust rather than the servant's tally.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each self is held against what it earns, failure to feed the powerless is condemned, and a day of account follows. Together these cues distinguish accountable action from putting a lien on its beneficiary: feeding must occur, but its moral account cannot be converted into debt owed by the poor.

activation_trace.role: The favor that burdens its recipient supplies the prohibited interpersonal debt.
Accumulating more supplies the creditor's hoped-for return or moral balance.
Seeking and obtaining one's own gain supplies the action for which the self, not its beneficiary, is accountable.
Collateral held for a right supplies the legal-economic image of binding by one's own account.
Feeding another supplies the positive act that the focus prohibition must purify rather than suppress.
The humiliation of destitution supplies the recipient's vulnerability to an imposed favor-debt.
Accounting and recompense supply the true forum of reckoning, displacing the giver's private ledger.

structural_cues: 74:38 states individual liability, and 74:43-46 lists omitted worship, omitted feeding, collective immersion, and denial of account.
The failure is not excessive generosity but failure to act without corrupting accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earning, collateral, failure to feed, poverty, and final account; I infer a contrast between responsibility for one's act and a claim imposed on its beneficiary. These later legal-economic images could instead remain independent of 74:6's immediate gift language.

changed_reading.after: Feed the vulnerable, but leave no lien on them: your deed binds your own account and does not make its recipient your debtor.

context_deltas.mechanism: If favor is used to accumulate allies, obligation, or rank, it resembles social capital stored for later rescue. The denial of benefit from an advocate joined to another makes that expected conversion fail.

activation_trace.role: A weighty favor supplies the obligation from which patronage capital is built.
Rivalry through greater number or status supplies the attempted accumulation of protective influence.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the expected payoff that is explicitly denied.
An advocate joining another supplies the social addition imagined to convert connections into rescue.

structural_cues: 74:48 closes the prisoners' account by denying efficacy to accumulated advocacy.
The move from individual liability in 74:38 to ineffective intercession in 74:48 limits transferable social credit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied benefit and an advocate added to another; I infer that favor-based social surplus cannot be cashed out as rescue. The verse may concern intercession strictly rather than ordinary patronage networks.

changed_reading.before: Do not give favors to acquire more allies or status.
changed_reading.after: Do not bank obligation as protective social capital; the added advocate cannot convert such accumulated standing into rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence conditions remembrance on divine willing and locates worthiness in God. In the opening commission, therefore, audience response cannot be treated as the worker's harvest, proof of magnitude, or return owed for warning.

activation_trace.role: The favor turned into a burden supplies the worker's temptation to claim an outcome from recipients.
Numerical increase supplies the audience or response metric the worker might appropriate.
Willing directed toward a thing supplies the condition placed above human response.
Bringing something to presence after forgetfulness supplies the audience outcome that is conditioned rather than owned.
Fitness and worthiness supply the quality explicitly located in God rather than earned by the messenger's totals.

structural_cues: The surah closes by repeating remembrance in 74:54-56 and then subordinating it to divine will.
This ending answers an opening commission whose visible results could otherwise become the object of تَسْتَكْثِرُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance conditioned on divine will and divine worthiness; I infer that the commissioned agent must release ownership of response metrics. The ending may primarily describe audience capacity rather than the messenger's motive.

changed_reading.before: Do not seek a larger return for the warning you deliver.
changed_reading.after: Do not count remembrance, adherents, or visible response as your yield; deliver the reminder while leaving its activation and worth to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و mapping and its transaction-increase branch at a surface that ordinarily denotes the Lord. It remains anchored by تَمْنُن as a burdening favor and تَسْتَكْثِرُ as sought increase, and it sharpens the nearby contrast between divine lordship and human surplus-seeking. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root activation, not as the lexical meaning of رَبِّ in 74:7.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus construction itself joins a burdening favor to sought abundance; the split context branch supplies an unusually exact surplus analogy.

activation_trace.role: The weight imposed by a favor supplies one side of a transaction seeking repayment.
Increase and abundance supply the surplus sought from that transaction.
The non-dominant split branch's increase in a transaction supplies a deliberately contained contrast between devotion for the Lord and extracting surplus.

changed_reading.before: Persist for your Lord without seeking more from favors.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, persistence for the Lord excludes treating service like a surplus-bearing transaction in which favor must reproduce itself as gain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates مَنّ as gratuitous release rather than the ordinary favor-reminding sense and carries later collateral and debt images back into 74:6. It remains visibly anchored in the focus contrast between release without compensation and seeking increase. Downstream prose should render it as a legal-economic analogy for hidden expectations, not as a direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The free-release branch of تَمْنُن at word 2 directly conflicts with seeking abundance at word 3 when an unspoken lien is retained.

activation_trace.role: Release without compensation supplies the stated gratuity whose integrity is under examination.
Increase and abundance supply the concealed larger repayment that would negate gratuity.
Collateral held against a right supplies the hidden lien that keeps the recipient bound.
Financial debt supplies the repayment logic covertly preserved beneath an apparent release.

changed_reading.before: Do not seek compensation for a favor.
changed_reading.after: Do not call an act gratuitous while preserving a hidden lien through which its beneficiary is expected to repay it with increase.

strongest_changes: The provision-to-craving sequence in 74:12-15 turns the focus verse into a bilateral critique of entitlement: giver and recipient can each convert grace into a claim.
The count-as-test and faith-increase sequence in 74:31 shows that increase itself is not rejected; personal ownership, object, and direction of increase are decisive.
The earning, collateral, feeding, and account sequence in 74:38-46 recasts clean generosity as action that binds the actor's account without placing a lien on the vulnerable recipient.
The closing dependence of remembrance on divine will releases the commissioned worker from treating audience response as personal yield.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaves as a compact anti-conversion rule: it blocks conversion of favor into leverage, service into self-magnitude, received bounty into entitlement, care into recipient debt, and response into the worker's metric, while preserving positive growth in faith.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation of تَسْتَكْثِرُ to the prohibition permits more than one causal or circumstantial rendering.
The cutting, sustaining-strength, measured-weight, and gratuitous-release branches of م ن ن are valid packet branches but remain form-distant from the strongest favor-reminding baseline.
The recipient-side mirror in 74:11-15 and the outcome-control reading from 74:54-56 are contextual extensions rather than direct syntactic glosses.
The split-root ر ب ب to ر ب و surplus activation must remain explicitly exploratory.
